description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'payments' extending 'erpnext.stock.StockController' for handling payment-related UI interactions in an ERPNext system, including payment creation, display, keyboard input, and amount calculations.

classes.name: payments
classes.description: A class managing payment dialog and processing in the ERPNext POS system, including methods for payment creation, display, amount handling, and user interaction.

methods.name: make_payment
methods.description: Initializes and displays the payment dialog, sets primary action, and prepares keyboard input.

methods.name: select_text
methods.description: Selects text in form controls when clicked.

methods.name: set_payment_primary_action
methods.description: Defines the primary action button for submitting the payment.

methods.name: make_keyboard
methods.description: Renders the payment template and sets up keyboard and amount controls.

methods.name: make_multimode_payment
methods.description: Creates a multi-mode payment entry based on outstanding amount.

methods.name: show_payment_details
methods.description: Displays current payment modes and highlights selected.

methods.name: set_outstanding_amount
methods.description: Sets and highlights the selected payment mode, updating the payment value.

methods.name: bind_keyboard_event
methods.description: Binds keyboard and control events for payment input.

methods.name: bind_form_control_event
methods.description: Binds click and change events for form controls.

methods.name: highlight_selected_row
methods.description: Highlights the selected payment mode row.

methods.name: bind_numeric_keys_event
methods.description: Binds numeric keypad input for payment amount entry.

methods.name: bind_amount_change_event
methods.description: Binds change event for amount input fields.

methods.name: update_paid_amount
methods.description: Updates the payment data with the current input.

methods.name: update_payment_amount
methods.description: Updates the payment amount in the data model.

methods.name: show_amounts
methods.description: Displays current amounts in the UI.
